newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli forces detain 13 Palestinians in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israeli forces detain 13 Palestinians in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli security forces have detained 13 Palestinians in the West Bank town of Hebron on suspicion of links with the militant Islamic Jihad group, Arab residents said on Tuesday.

They said two were detained on Monday while trying to send a fax to Islamic Jihad headquarters in Syria and nine were rounded up in a raid on dormitories of the Islamic University. The other two also were detained on Monday but the circumstances of their arrest were unclear.
Israeli spokesmen declined to comment on the report.
Israel regards Hebron, the focus of intense negotiations with the Palestine Liberation Organisation on a long-overdue Israeli army redeployment, as a hotbed of Islamic militancy.

Some 400 Jews live or study amidst 100,000 Palestinians in Hebron and right-wing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu wants to modify security arrangements agreed in a partial pullout deal signed by its previous Labour-led government.
Human rights groups say that more than 5,000 Palestinians are being held by Israel on various charges related to resistance to Israeli occupation.
